notes.title: Big Update
notes.content:
We're back with a big update that fixes a lot of bugs and introduces a lot of new features!

Fixed bugs:
1 - Stuttering between interfaces.
2 - Transitions between levels.
3 - Chapter selection and puzzles within the chapter.
4 - Stuttering between dialogs.
5 - Seeing through walls.
6 - Problems with UV light.

What's new:
1 - A new story flow and brand new user experience.
2 - More suspect interrogation and deciding the culprit.
3 - A sense of trust between police officers and the player.
